title: af/ProjectSurveysSettled@1
description: The machine-local record `settled.json` beside `project.lock` of a Project Store (ADR-0152 clause 13): the collected Surveys whose own records have left the CAS, deleted at their name or settled from a dead pass's container. Collection adds a Survey under the Store's lock once its record has left its CAS name and before it is unlinked; every later inventory reads it, so a file at a settled Survey's CAS name is `foreign` even when its bytes hash to the Survey ID, sweep after sweep. Sorted, each Survey once; no path.
